text: The tenth day is over, and tomorrow morning by 7.30 or 8 we will come to the conclusion of this ten day Dhamma seminar.
So, this evening let us review what you practice during these ten days, what you have practiced.
So that any aspect of the technique, if it is not clear, it will become clear. If it is clear, it will become clearer.
So, let us review what you did. Of course, the technique is very deep. In ten days you have taken just a few steps on the path, and the path is very long path.
We won't discuss the deeper aspects of the technique, because according to the tradition, the theory and the practice should go together.
